title: Core item properties
note: Applies to EVERY item (its properties block): the economy, weight, stacking and how its name is shown.

base_value.note: Base economic / sale value in dollars ($). Mandatory on every item in the catalog.

weight_kg.note: Physical weight in kilograms (kg). Mandatory on every item in the catalog.

max_stack_size.note: Maximum inventory stack count (integer >= 1). Mandatory on every item in the catalog.

pack_quantity.label: Pack Quantity
pack_quantity.note: How many individual items this one stands for (a stack, pallet, case or bundle of N). The game SHOWS the name as 'Name xN' (then its weight, 'Name xN (9 kg)', when Show Weight In Name is on); keep the stored name plain ('Cement Bag Pallet', never 'Cement Bag (Pallet of 10)'). Leave empty for a single item.

display_weight.label: Show Weight In Name
display_weight.note: Materials and packaged goods only: the game shows the name as 'Name (9 kg)' / 'Name (20 lb)', generated from weight_kg and converted by the Metric / Imperial setting. A pack (pack_quantity set) shows its quantity first, 'Name x10 (200 kg)'. Never type a weight into the name itself.

is_consumable.note: Whether the item is consumed / depleted upon use. Mandatory on every item in the catalog.

is_spawnable.note: Whether this asset is placed into the world during terrain generation. When true, the asset must also declare a 'spawning' block naming at least one target biome (spawning.biomes[]). When false or absent, the asset exists only as an inventory/crafting item and is never scattered by the generator. Defaults to false when omitted, so older manifests stay valid.

is_buyable.label: Buyable
is_buyable.note: Whether the shops sell it (false = a gift or reward item). Present on nearly every manifest; the catalog export writes it explicitly.

is_sellable.label: Sellable
is_sellable.note: Whether the player can sell it back to a shop.
